claims.claim: The amber garden trial reported stronger recall.
claims.supporting_quote: The amber garden trial reported stronger recall after four guided sessions among learners from purely invented campuses.

claims.claim: The ivory harbor trial reported 64% stronger recall.
claims.supporting_quote: The ivory harbor trial reported 64% stronger recall after four guided sessions among learners from invented campuses.

synthesis: The amber garden trial reported 64% stronger recall (Lumen, 2024). The ivory harbor trial reported 64% stronger recall (Vale, 2024).
